description: Clear roles, responsibilities and lines of accountability for the AI system are established.
name: rmf_govern_accountability_assigned

description: Applicable legal and regulatory requirements involving AI are understood and managed.
name: rmf_govern_legal_requirements_mapped

description: AI risk management policies and processes are in place and applied across the AI lifecycle.
name: rmf_govern_policies_in_place

description: AI incidents and negative impacts are responded to, recovered from, and communicated.
name: rmf_manage_incident_response

description: Each identified risk is treated — mitigated, transferred, avoided, or formally accepted.
name: rmf_manage_risk_treated

description: AI risks are prioritized and acted upon based on assessment and impact.
name: rmf_manage_risks_prioritized

description: Risks from third-party AI resources (models, data, services) are identified and managed.
name: rmf_manage_thirdparty_risks

description: The context — intended purpose, setting, and the AI system's role — is established and documented before deployment.
name: rmf_map_context_established

description: Potential impacts, benefits and risks to individuals, groups, communities and society are mapped.
name: rmf_map_impacts_characterized

description: The AI system is categorized by its capabilities, intended use, and risk level.
name: rmf_map_system_categorized

description: The AI system is measured for fairness, with harmful bias identified and managed.
name: rmf_measure_fairness_bias

description: Mechanisms are in place to track identified AI risks and system performance over time.
name: rmf_measure_ongoing_tracking

description: The AI system is measured for the secure-&-resilient and privacy-enhanced characteristics.
name: rmf_measure_security_privacy

description: The AI system is measured for the accountable-&-transparent and explainable-&-interpretable characteristics.
name: rmf_measure_transparency_explainability

description: The AI system is measured for the validity & reliability and safety trustworthiness characteristics before deployment.
name: rmf_measure_validity_safety
